title: audx project config
description: audx.json: where `npx @litlab/audx` writes sounds and which theme it uses.

theme.description: Theme for new sounds: a registry name (minimal, playful, mechanical, retro), a URL, or a path to a theme .json file.

dir.description: Directory for generated sound modules, relative to this file.

registry.description: Registry base URL. Defaults to https://audx.site/api.
